limits: Owned localhost fixtures, disposable profiles and deny proxies only. No live sites, personal browser profiles or new software.
Module Engine pages: first paint is covered by unit tests (the cached choice applies synchronously while theme.js runs) and the <head> placement check, not by paint timing.
Websites: the setting is read asynchronously at document start, so a page's first moment can still be light; no paint-timing measurement was made.
Filter-based website darkening dulls strongly saturated media, inverts stylesheet background pictures and can hide dark transparent logos; per-site exceptions are the remedy.
The native colour picker UI cannot be automated; its value and input/change events were set directly.
Engine-specific website rules (top layer, backdrop, canvas, scrollbar) follow behaviour measured in Chrome 157 and Firefox 160; the pixel checks guard it.

The Firefox userscript layout suite fails intermittently in its install-update and external-editor steps, including on the untouched baseline commit; this is unresolved and not attributed to this change.
One Chrome navigation attempt hit a CDP reload race in the harness wait helper; later runs passed.

Firefox reports "Promise resolved after context unloaded" when a page closes while a content script awaits extension storage. The suites exempted only content.js; the exemption now also names src/appearance/website-theme.js, with the same exact messages. Chromium runs are unaffected: those filters apply to Firefox only.
